==Demand an explanation==
* ''"We're glad you have enjoyed our servicessss. Perhaps some fuel would be an appropriate compensssation?"''
*# Give them the 15 fuel they demand. &nbsp;[ {{Transaction|15|subtract_fuel}} ]
*#* ''You transfer the fuel and they release your ship. "Tell your friendsss about us!" Their portable station slips into the clouds.''
*#** Nothing else happens.
*# That's ridiculous!
*#* ''"I'm ssssorry to hear that." He presses a button and an explosion rocks the ship. They must have planted a bomb while 'repairing'! Prepare for a fight!''
*#** Your ship takes <span style="color:red">5 hull</span> damage, 1 damage to a random <span style="color:red">system</span>, and you fight the [[Slug Ships|Slug ship]] ([[Rewards#Default_rewards|default rewards]]).
* ''"We're glad you have enjoyed our servicessss. Now for payment. To enssssure your cooperation we've taken the liberty of installing a limiter on your weapons system."''
*# Give them the 50 scrap they demand. &nbsp;[ {{Transaction|50|subtract_scrap}} ]
*#* ''You transfer the scrap and they release your ship. "Tell your friendsss about us!" Their portable station slips into the clouds.''
*#** Nothing else happens.
*# Let's get out of here!
*#* ''You activate your thrusters and force your way away from the station. A ship quickly moves in to engage. You'll need to get out of here fast; there may not be time to get the weapons fully operational!''
*#** You fight the [[Slug Ships|Slug ship]] with your <span style="color: #c90f0f">{{tooltip|Weapon Control halved|rounds down against you}}</span>.
*#*** {{Winning|destroyed=true|The Slug ship breaks apart and your weapon system returns to normal. You collect what you can.}}<br />{{Winning|deadCrew=true|With their crew dead, you quickly shut off their hacking module and your weapon system returns to normal. You strip the ship.}}
*#**** You receive high [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].

==Trivia==
This event is called "NEBULA_SLUG_HULLFIX" in the datafiles.
* Revisiting the beacon will remove systems malfunction, but the enemy ship and rewards will be exactly the same.
